appearance_facts.fact: A single pie chart occupies the central area, divided into four colored slices by white radial lines.
A pale-yellow slice labeled 'Nuclear (40%)' is the largest visible wedge, spanning from the top vertical radius to the lower-left.
An orange slice labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)' is the smallest visible wedge, spanning from the top vertical radius to the right.
A red slice labeled 'Hydroelectric (25%)' sits between the Nuclear and Renewables slices.
A reddish-orange slice labeled 'Renewables (20%)' sits between the Hydroelectric and Fossil Fuels slices.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.

public_definitions: User goal: 'Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.'
Routing criterion (readonly): 'Largest global energy consumption category'.
Option conditions: 'Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring', 'Route Hydroelectric to priority source monitoring', 'Keep Renewables on routine source monitoring'.
